{{Top|leg}}
'''Ion field generators''' created ionic pulses, effectively generating a field capable of shutting down technology within range. The [[EXVR-1 Guardian Grid]] used a network of ion field generators which were capable of shutting down [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
